briefs.claim_en: Drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice will destroy the coronavirus.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations, including FactCheck.org (April 2, 2020), Politifact (March 24, 2020), AFP (March 12, 2020), AP News, Alt News (March 18, 2020), Snopes.com (March 26, 2020), and FACTLY (April 17, 2020), have debunked the claim that drinking hot water with lemon juice can destroy or cure the coronavirus. These sources state there is no scientific evidence to support such claims and that health officials have refuted them. Vishvas News (May 25, 2020) also found similar claims about inhaling steam with various ingredients to be false. CBS News (May 5, 2020) and Cleveland Clinic (April 28, 2020) also clarified that acidic liquids like lemon juice do not kill the coronavirus.
